overlayVsBakeQuestion.dispatchAsk: livingAreaSqft already reaches some live golds through the HTTP overlay (Caldwell 972, Hays 2,444, Williamson 842) while the bake row carried nothing before this card. Say which one Wave R publishes and whether the overlay should survive.
overlayVsBakeQuestion.traced: The live overlay is wired in artifacts/api-server/src/routes/brokerageNodeFacets.ts (and propertyExplorer.ts), which import loadStructuralFactAtom / resolveStructuralFactRead and attach a request-time-computed structuralFact.livingAreaSqft onto the served facets, independent of the static baked snapshot row this card patches (payload_json.baseFacts.cadRoll.livingAreaSqft).
overlayVsBakeQuestion.recommendation: The overlay should survive. It is the fresher, request-time value and (per the provenance fix verified above) now correctly labeled as sourced from cad_property, so it agrees with the newly-baked static value wherever CAD data exists. Wave R's job was never to replace the live overlay -- it was to fix the DIFFERENT gap: any consumer that reads place_layer_snapshots directly without hitting the live route (bulk exports, PMTiles, any future offline consumer) previously saw a completely empty cadRoll block. That gap is now closed. No code change is needed to make these two paths agree; they already read the same source table.
